items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1960-01-21
items.q: His name was Adolph Alexander Senior. He used to arrange for Celestan.

ctx.x: He says, Daddy was a trumpet player. What was his name?
His name was Adolph Alexander Senior. His name was Adolph Alexander Senior. He used to arrange for Celestan. He used to arrange for Celestan. Right. So he used to arrange for Celestan.
